lesson.title: Sori Length

sections.title: What is a Sori Unit?
sections.content: A sori unit is a way to measure length. One sori unit measures six centimetres (Section 1).

sections.title: Calculating Five Units
sections.content:
To find the length of five units, we multiply the size of one unit by five.

Calculation:
6 centimetres × 5 = 30 centimetres

Five sori units measure thirty centimetres (Section 1).

sections.content: A half means making two groups that have the same number in each group (Section: 1).

4 units × 7 grams per unit = 28 grams.

The total length of five sori units is thirty centimetres (Section 1).

lesson.title: Understanding Halves

sections.title: What is a Half?
sections.content: A half means making two groups that have the same number in each group (Section 1).

sections.title: Example: Seed Halves
sections.content: If you have eight seeds, a half is four seeds. This is because eight divided into two equal groups gives you four in each group (Section 1).

lesson.title: Understanding One Third

sections.title: What is One Third?
sections.content: One third means one of three equal parts of a whole group (Section: 1). To be 'equal' means each part has the same number (Section: 1).

sections.title: Example with Apples
sections.content: If there are twelve apples and three people share them equally, each person gets four apples. This is because one third of twelve is four (Section: 1).

lesson.summary: One third represents an equal division of a whole into three parts. In the example provided, sharing twelve apples among three people results in four apples for each person.
